name: Temporary fiber probe: spatial-overlap scenarios
status: ILLUSTRATIVE; efficiencies are the user's example, not new measurements

probe.notes: A/B use one probe fiber; C/D use another via temporary steering mirrors. Fixed reference alignment and calibrated relay losses are still unconfirmed. Unit common throughput is a scenario assumption.

gaussian_model.profile: Equal-waist Gaussian modes at one transverse reference plane; initial displacement only along x
gaussian_model.width_definition: w is the 1/e field radius, equivalently the 1/e^2 intensity radius
gaussian_model.notes: q=k*w*theta is a dimensionless D-arm phase slope relative to C, not a fitted or measured tilt. Displacement signs are alternative scenarios with identical probe power efficiencies.
